A kan claim detail view: expand a claim to its full text, kind, author, recorded_at, artifact anchor, and cites. UX note from the user: the kan-claims view is a DIFFERENT TAB from the agent/harness interface view — they are separate surfaces — but the claim detail should be pulled up contextually when a specific claim is referenced elsewhere (e.g. a cite, a verdict, a handoff). Extends the Step 3 two-pane browser (subject-claim-drill-in / two-pane-claim-browser) from a one-line-per-claim list into a full detail pane. Serves honest-ambiguity (show the whole claim, not a truncated summary).

claim-detail-view design (.design/claim-detail-view.md): Extend the two-pane browser so you can drill from a subject's claim list into a single claim's full detail: its kind, id, author, time, subject, artifact anchor, untruncated (scrollable) text, and each cite resolved to a one-line preview. Navigation is a three-level focus — Subjects → Claims → Detail — that Enter descends and Esc ascends. It shows the whole claim rather than a truncated line, serving honest-ambiguity and kan-is-truth. adversarial review of claim-detail-view: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS — adversarial review of the UX bundle (claim-detail-view + claim-visual-formatting + process-atom-telos-views): all ACs met with load-bearing tests, 43/43 pass, clippy -D warnings clean, builds; faithful to kan-is-truth (reads only, no synthesis), honest-ambiguity (deferral note, honest retraction/undated), readable-claim-browser (untruncated detail, resolved cites, short_cid verified live incl retracts @gouwv3p). Follow-ups: (1) atom_scroll/telos_scroll increment unclamped in the key handler (tui.rs ~567/577) so scroll-up lags after holding j — no panic, draw clamps, but janky and untested; (2) extract_fenced uses an unanchored substring find, prefix-fragile though safe for day's fixed vocabulary; (3) new substrate helpers not rustfmt-clean and str_array_at/json_str_array are duplicates.
